noncounting_pipeline_reuse.rule: Join all seventeen exact pointers by full original path, source_commit, SHA256 and accepted-owner set. Preserve the numeric sourceb6 direct reference to checkpoint05 as well as checkpoint06/08/09/10/11 and the source295 same-checkpoint12 reference to source957. counting_rule: Export exactly eight executed stage roots and five complete original final pipelines. Preserve four failed normal stages and all twenty-five held stage instances by their original source and stage. Count only the four reported accepted owners after complete original normal/kernel/full-owned/source verification. Two B13 failures at different sources remain distinct historical attempts; the later source295 reuse of source957 Crossing adds no owner. No deployed source, observed stdout capture, prior accepted supplier, aggregate theorem or whole P1.4 claim gains acceptance here.

submission_gate: Root must independently verify checkpoint11, bind its actual archive SHA to the sole required argument and plan, and publish the exact checkpoint12 script/plan before a single source-bound read-only export invocation. This preparation submits no task and compiles no owner. The first three raw pipeline pins come only from existing diag03 originals; the remaining two raw pipeline hashes cannot be replaced by stdout-canonical hashes.
command_argument_validation: Exactly one mandatory argument of 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters. Before receipt collection, require checkpoint-11.tar.xz to be a regular non-symlink file and its SHA256 to equal the Root-approved argument. Record that verified actual hash in EXPORT_MANIFEST.json. No default, hash guess or auto-sealing is permitted.
